site_area_sqm.reason: Computable from the submitted provisional polygon; not an official precise-area basis.

building_footprint_area_sqm.reason: Illustrative design geometry, not a surveyed building inventory.

green_ratio.reason: Illustrative submitted-design ratio, not an existing or statutory target.

public_space_ratio.reason: Illustrative submitted-design ratio, not an existing or statutory target.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved controls, official boundary and surveyed floor area are unavailable.

key_area_count.reason: The announcement names three areas; submitted polygons remain provisional.

scenario_node_count.reason: Counts proposed nodes/contracts, not implemented services.

landmark_count.reason: Counts three conceptual, reversible pilgrimage landmarks.

industry_validation_scenario_count.reason: Counts controlled concept-stage validation contracts, not accredited test institutions.

spatial_prototype_count.reason: One non-isomorphic prototype is assigned to each provisional key area.

physical_component_count.reason: Counts five participant-authored components in the selected reference section.

layout_alternative_count.reason: Three same-width concept layouts are compared using one declared frame.

comparison_segment_length_m.reason: Participant-selected reference length, not surveyed geometry.

comparison_total_width_m.reason: Participant-selected total reference width, not an observed site width.

selected_protected_human_width_m.reason: Concept target to be replaced by survey and professional accessibility/fire review.

selected_crossings_per_100m.formula: count(planned human-machine crossings in ALT-C per 100 m)
selected_crossings_per_100m.reason: Concept geometry comparison, not a field conflict count.

selected_max_yield_distance_m.reason: Concept target under the declared bay-spacing rule, not an as-built distance.

selected_emergency_path_continuity_ratio.formula: continuous human-spine length in power-off layout / test length
selected_emergency_path_continuity_ratio.reason: Diagrammatic continuity test only; not fire or accessibility certification.

selected_machine_path_index.formula: ALT-C conceptual machine path / ALT-A conceptual machine path
selected_machine_path_index.reason: The selected layout is intentionally worse for machine path length than fully mixed ALT-A.

machine_path_penalty_ratio.reason: Explicit adverse trade-off accepted for continuous human priority and physical recovery.

scenario_contract_count.reason: Counts machine-readable concept contracts, not deployed services.

same_task_human_baseline_coverage_ratio.reason: Contract-field coverage only; real baseline-service availability is unknown.

operator_role_coverage_ratio.reason: Every contract names a suggested role; no appointment is claimed.

stop_recovery_coverage_ratio.reason: Contract completeness only; field recoverability remains unknown.

persona_count.reason: Design lenses, not interviewed or observed people.

scenario_persona_acceptance_cell_count.reason: Counts planned acceptance questions; no field acceptance is claimed.

yield_tabletop_fixture_count.reason: Twelve contracts × seven synthetic conditions; not a participant sample.

yield_tabletop_negative_fixture_count.reason: Six synthetic negative conditions per scenario.

yield_tabletop_unsafe_release_count.reason: Zero in the deterministic script only; not a field safety claim.

yield_tabletop_pass_ratio.reason: Expected/actual match for participant-authored deterministic rules only.

implementation_package_count.reason: Counts suggested delivery packages, not approved projects.

raci_role_count.reason: Counts role types, not appointed organisations or people.

resource_band_count.reason: Relative L1/L2/L3 complexity only, with no currency or funding claim.

annual_program_month_count.reason: Suggested month-by-month gates, not an approved schedule.

public_ledger_field_count.reason: Fields in a proposed public ledger; the ledger is not operating.

local_official_context_source_count.reason: Five public official or official-republication pages used within stated limits.

global_case_count.reason: Eight mechanism references; no local statistics or policy transfer.

field_human_wait_seconds.formula: median(observed completion time with ordinary human baseline)
field_human_wait_seconds.reason: Requires authorised field observation and an agreed same-task baseline.

field_recovery_seconds.formula: time from stop trigger to restored ordinary service
field_recovery_seconds.reason: No field drill has been run.

field_accessible_route_pass_ratio.formula: professionally accepted accessible-route checks / checks run
field_accessible_route_pass_ratio.reason: Requires survey, professional review and user participation.

field_no_account_completion_ratio.formula: same-task completions without account/device / eligible attempts
field_no_account_completion_ratio.reason: Contract parity is specified, but no public service has been trialled.

field_near_miss_count.formula: operator-verified human-machine near misses per authorised test window
field_near_miss_count.reason: No device or field window exists.

field_rain_night_pass_ratio.formula: accepted rain/night recovery drills / drills run
field_rain_night_pass_ratio.reason: Rain/night behaviour remains a test requirement, not observed evidence.

field_public_acceptance_ratio.formula: accepted scenario-persona cells / valid field cells reviewed
field_public_acceptance_ratio.reason: The 84-cell matrix is planned, not completed participation.
